part_2_alumnus_profile.subject: Scott Brodie (Alumnus)
part_2_alumnus_profile.orewa_misnomer_origin: Associated with Orewa solely due to the location of the 2007 Under-15 King of Rail competition victory.

corporate_identity_clash.duplicate_name_role: CFO / Chartered Accountant at AVA Timber
corporate_identity_clash.verification_status: Falsely mapped by online algorithms. The Rangitoto alumnus never entered corporate timber or finance sectors.

community_legacy.memorial_details: A physical memorial tribute was established at Browns Bay Skatepark by local peers to honour his place in the riding scene.

part_3_industry_cornerstone.subject: Andrew Morrison (Morri)
industry_footprint: Exclusive NZ importer for global brands Independent Trucks and Santa Cruz for over 20 years.
Founder of 1990s underground brand Strobe and producer of the film Illumination Process.
Co-founder of After Hours Skateboards alongside daughter Billie Morrison.
Oral history preserved in Manual Magazine BINZ Podcast (Episode 1).

registry_assessment.status: Completely clean of criminal or regulatory allegations.
registry_assessment.misidentification_notes: A 2019 disciplinary infraction belongs to a separate Wellington-based lawyer named Andrew MacLean Morrison.

regional_intersections.community_infrastructure: Intersections with North Harbour community board chairman Kyle Kyle regarding local youth and park resources.
regional_intersections.subculture_context: The 2000s/2010s North Shore alternative scene was heavily impacted by local entities, including the Browns Bay properties and synthetic substance commercialisation of Matt Bowden.
